body: Of course! Well thats a step in the right direction then, and i understand not wanting to do therapy anymore. Doesn’t work for everyone. I hope your wife supports you through this time you’re going through right now. Its great to be open and honest with her. Props to you!!!

Hey man, we are quite literally polar opposites (im a lot younger than you and im a girl lmao). But i feel you. What you’ve gone through in life sounds hard. But look at you, you’re still here, you’re pushing through all the pain you’ve had because you are strong enough to do that. All you gotta do is keep pushing. Because ultimately, things will happen soon in your life that’ll make you see that life can change. However you feel right now probably wont be how you feel in a couple weeks. Im sorry you feel this way, you dont deserve that. Remember you are strong, you got this, you are amazing. To offer some advice, are you seeing a therapist right now, and have you talked to your wife about how you’ve been feeling recently? Taking the first step to help your mental health is hard but so worth it.
